subject.title: Support installing all skills/plugins from a publisher

question: Should publisher-wide installation be a skills-only convenience command now, or should ClawHub first define a unified contract that also installs publisher plugin packages?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing bulk-install mode, and plugin packages do not share the same installation lifecycle as skills; source-level implementation cannot safely choose that product boundary.

options.title: Ship skills-only bulk install
options.body: Add an explicit publisher skills command while leaving plugin package installation as its existing separate workflow.

options.title: Define unified publisher installation
options.body: Design and approve plugin package selection, verification, permission, update, and partial-failure semantics before exposing one command for both artifact types.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the current per-skill and package workflows until maintainers prioritize a broader publisher onboarding experience.

recommendation.title: Ship skills-only bulk install
recommendation.body: Add an explicit publisher skills command while leaving plugin package installation as its existing separate workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the collaborator who has recently contributed publisher-aware CLI behavior and raised the related command-surface consolidation proposal.
